title: Refactor and Extend Mathematical Crates
description:
Refactor and extend mathematical crates. They are not properly abstracted and not extensive: mathematical_core mixes graph markers with layout algorithms and a duplicated Vec2; mathematical_graph is actually an interactive board engine leaking ui_styling/infinite_cavas into a "mathematical" crate; there are no classic graph algorithms (BFS/DFS/topo/SCC/shortest path) despite many crates hand-rolling them; only 1 of 12 mathematical crates has a UI counterpart.

Plan: purify mathematical/* (zero ui_styling/infinite_cavas deps), extract the interactive engine to infinite/board/*, consolidate geometry into mathematical/geometry, linear algebra into mathematical/algebra, layout/drawing into mathematical/graph/drawing, extend mathematical/graph with real graph algorithms (traversal, topological sort, cycles, components, shortest paths), migrate hand-rolled consumer algorithms onto them, and add a single combined `mathematical` UI plugin with one window per framework (graph, layout, geometry, algebra, matrix).

Full approved plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/refactor-and-extend-mathematical-fluffy-bonbon.md
summary:
Root-caused the puzzle 2D zoom/selection regression to four compounding issues introduced/left over from the premigration→framework-shell migration: (1) puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx called session.renderFrame() and dispatch("setCamera") synchronously on every raw wheel/pointermove event with no rAF-coalescing or settle-debounce (premigration had this via scheduleInputInvalidate()); (2) every dispatched action re-ran os-shell.tsx's refreshUi(), sequentially awaiting plugin.render() for all 3 puzzle2d panes + every panel tab + tools + engagements + measures + labels; (3) puzzle/plugin/rs's puzzle2d_board_scene() unconditionally re-serialized the whole fixture to JSON on every pane render (3x per action); (4) BoardHost's set_hovered_id/set_hovered_kind/set_hovered_id_silent/set_highlighted_ids bumped content_scene_generation on every hover change, forcing a full icon/base-layer rebuild even though hover only affects the always-fresh overlay layers (confirmed inconsistent with the already-correct, already-tested selection-does-not-bump-generation behavior).

Fixed: added scheduleRender() rAF-coalescing plus a pendingCameraDispatchRef debounced through the existing 350ms camera-settle timer in puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx; parallelized os-shell.tsx refreshUi()'s render/tools/engagements/measures/labels calls via Promise.all; added an fnv1a-hash-keyed fixture_json cache (cached_fixture_json) in puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs so the 3 panes of one action reuse one serialized string; removed the four hover/highlight bump_content_scene_generation() calls in mathematical/graph/port/directed/normal/rs/lib.rs. Added a puzzle2d_board_scene cache-reuse test in puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs and a hover-does-not-bump-generation test in puzzle/2d/rs/lib.rs (mirroring the existing selection test). Verified: mathematical_graph_port_directed_normal compiles clean; framework/renderer/react's full suite (97 tests) and lint pass; scoped tsc check shows no new type errors. Full workspace cargo build is currently blocked by unrelated concurrent changes from other live sessions (vcs/framework-os API mismatch, a missing protocol/plugin/rs workspace member) — not caused by this ticket's changes, left untouched per the no-fix-others'-WIP rule.

Spun off a follow-up (spatial index for BoardHost hit-testing — pre-existing O(n)/O(n·m) linear scans, not part of this regression) as a separate suggested task rather than bundling it into this ticket.
